einzeiler: Conversation with country music legend Tanya Tucker and current news topics.
kurzfassung: Country music icon Tanya Tucker discusses her decades-long career and music. The episode also covers various news headlines ranging from politics to local developments. Additionally, upcoming tour dates and projects are mentioned.
stichpunkte: Country singer Tanya Tucker's career and music
Trump's policy pledge regarding US adults
Nicolas Cage sinkhole drama and neighborhood evacuations
The condition of the Santa Monica Promenade
beschreibung:
Tanya Tucker is a legendary country singer who rose to fame as a child in the early 1970s, scoring hits like “Delta Dawn” and “What’s Your Mama’s Name?” and becoming one of country music’s most enduring stars. Her career has spanned more than five decades, earning her multiple Grammy Awards and a reputation for her powerful voice, outlaw-country edge, and influence on generations of female country artists. Check out her new song ‘Do We Want to Win’ made for the ‘Reagan’ movie soundtrack which will be back in theaters September 25th.

IN THE NEWS: Trump pledges $5K payout to US adults if Republicans win the midterms — so he can ‘finish the job’, Gavin Newsom brags about giving welfare to illegal aliens, KAREN BASS SAYS POT HOLES AREN’T HER FAULT, Nicolas Cage sinkhole drama escalates as neighbors are forced to evacuate, The Santa Monica Promenade is now empty storefronts with no customers.
